claims.text: Cole was still serving as Chairman of the House Appropriations Committee as of a committee press release dated 24 June 2026.
Tom Cole (R-OK) is identified as Chairman of the House Appropriations Committee in a committee press release dated 24 June 2026.

edges.label: Chairman, House Appropriations Committee
edges.note: Start date corrected from the board's earlier undated entry. Ratified by the House Republican Conference on 10 April 2024, succeeding Kay Granger mid-term in the 118th Congress. Still in the chair as of a committee release dated 24 June 2026. He therefore did not hold a 119(e)(2) seat on the date of the Grusch testimony.
